main_result.xi_c_definition: ξ_c = v/λ = 2cτ  (coherence length = 2 × propagation speed × relaxation time)
main_result.derivation_route: telegrapher Green's function G_q(Δx,t) integrated over t gives exp(-λ|Δx|/v)

key_identification.xi_c_in_PRW_params: ξ_c = v/λ = c/λ = 2cτ   (c=PRW speed, λ=reversal rate, τ=1/(2λ))
key_identification.xi_c_from_data: ξ_c = 2 × c × T₂*   if τ = T₂* (requires independent measurement of c)
key_identification.single_param_links_two_observables: τ_B controls BOTH the NM Gaussian onset (C(t) ~ exp(-Γt²/2τ_B)) AND the spatial correlation length ξ_c = 2cτ_B. These are independent observables tied to one parameter.

C2_PRW_substrate.key_constraint: xi_c = 2 * c * T2star  (same tau links spatial and temporal)
